# 🦞 Lobster Library

> The nano Solana financial trading, deep research, ML prediction market & agentic vision AI agent library

## Overview
80+ Solana and x402 payment agents for Solana DeFi, perpetuals, quantitative trading, and autonomous market analysis. Now natively integrated into the OpenClawd / solana-clawd monorepo and served at **https://x402.wtf/library**.

## Live Endpoints
- Landing page: <https://x402.wtf/library/>
- JSON index:    <https://x402.wtf/library/index.json>
- Meta:          <https://x402.wtf/library/meta.json>
- Schema:        <https://x402.wtf/library/schema/speraxAgentSchema_v1.json>
- Single agent:  <https://x402.wtf/library/{agent-id}.json>

## Categories
- Trading & DEX (Jupiter, Drift, Raydium, MEV protection)
- ML & Prediction (price prediction, sentiment analysis, anomaly detection)
- DeFi & Yield (yield optimization, liquid staking, lending)
- Risk Management (portfolio VaR, position sizing, protocol risk)
- Deep Research (tokenomics, audits, whitepapers, narrative tracking)
- Technical Analysis (indicators, chart pattern recognition)
- Infrastructure (RPC, Anchor, bots, data pipelines)
- Strategies (memecoins, airdrops, NFTs, market making)
- Macro (economics, regulation, forensics)
- Agentic (multi-agent orchestration, autonomous trading)
- Payments (x402 routing, wallet approvals, treasury float, settlement)

## npm Packages

- `@openclawd/lobster-library` — the full catalog as an npm package, served from x402.wtf/library
- `agentwallet-vault` (`npm install -g agentwallet-vault`) — AES-256-GCM encrypted keypair vault for Solana + EVM. REST API at `http://localhost:9099/api`. One-shot: `agentwallet serve`. Wallet-guardian and payment agents fetch signing keys from this vault. Deploy remotely: `agentwallet deploy e2b` or `agentwallet deploy cloudflare`.

## API
- Index:    https://x402.wtf/library/index.json
- Agent:    https://x402.wtf/library/{agent-id}.json
- Schema:   https://x402.wtf/library/schema/speraxAgentSchema_v1.json

## Workspace integration
- npm package name: `@openclawd/lobster-library`
- Listed in pnpm workspace at `library/`
- Build & sync: `node scripts/sync-library.mjs` (or `npm run library:build`)
- Mirrored into `public/library/` and served by the main Vite app at `x402.wtf/library/*`
